Retail Measurement System is the key focus of Nielsen IQ and we are moving towards providing a 360 degree view of retail information around the world. This role is to validate and sign off the features developed in RMS. To ensure the quality of the data we are reporting to our customers are accurate and in line with their requirement. Establish right process to ensure quality of the deliverable on a monthly basis and work in an agile way. Perform technical and functional validations whenever required to validate the output. Hands on experience in right technical skills needed for a backend validation and some coding basics to perform automation.

Responsibility:

Responsible for both the design, development and implementation of short- and long-term solutions to information technology (IT) needs through new and existing applications, systems architecture, network systems and applications infrastructure and the management of the IT infrastructure within an organization. 

Conducts a wide range of quality control tests and analyses to ensure that software meets or exceeds specified standards and end user requirements | Performs quality assurance and testing in an environment that typically uses state-of-the-art software applications testing processes (i.e., testing "clean room") but may also include manual QA/Testing | Drafts, revises and approves test plans and scripts to ensure alignment with standards and IT strategy | Creates test data files with valid and invalid records to thoroughly test program logic and verify system flow | Collaborates with users to plan user acceptance testing, alpha and beta testing | Ensures that system tests are successfully completed and documented and all problems are resolved | May develop, revise and approve quality assurance and testing policies, standards and procedure

Good automation skills with hands on experience. Prepare test data required for validations using sql and validate all possible scenarios for every projects assigned. Perform regression testing every release and provide sign off on time with accuracy. Analyze and prepare test plan, test cases for future projects with proper estimates. Documenting functional topics and maintaining standard test suite for all functionalities. Update the test suite every release with new cases introduced.

Qualification:

1. Minimum 1-3 years of experience of Functional and backend testing experience. 

2. Hands on test automation development using Selenium , Playwright or any standard framework.

3. Good SQL skills and Python, Shell scripting. 

4. Hands on experience in test case, test plan and test strategy creation.

5. Basics of AI/ML and using AI coding assistants such as Copilot in day to day work

title: IT Validation & Automation Engineer
description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.
The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.
In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.
In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

Role: Validation Automation Engineer 

Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India 

Work mode: Hybrid, Weekly 3 Days WFO

Experience: 5–8+ years 

Reporting line: Manager 
Role Overview 
Eurofins BioPharma Product Testing (BPT) operates a global network of bio/pharmaceutical GMP product testing laboratories. BPT is supported by global engineering teams developing and maintaining business-critical laboratory applications, including eLIMS-BPT, Eurofins ELN, eQMS and related platforms. 
As a Validation Automation Engineer within the BPT delivery and validation function, the successful candidate will ensure continuity, accuracy and compliance of release-validation activities while progressively automating repetitive work. The role combines hands-on IT validation, controlled documentation, requirements traceability and software automation. Quality, compliance and human review remain central as existing processes are converted into reliable and reusable solutions. 
Required Experience and Skills: 
- 5 to 8 years of relevant experience in software quality engineering, IT validation, test automation or quality/compliance roles supporting regulated applications. 
- Hands-on experience performing validation activities for major and minor releases, patches, emergency changes and production data updates. 
- Experience reviewing release scope, user requirements, Product Backlog Items (PBIs), defects and supporting test evidence for completeness and consistency. Ability to prepare, maintain and reconcile validation checklists, Requests for Change (RfCs), Module Functional Definitions (MFDs), release item lists and requirements traceability records. 
- Good understanding of controlled documentation, document lifecycle, revision history, effectivity dates, review and approval workflows, and audit-ready record keeping. 
- Ability to identify missing evidence, documentation gaps, traceability discrepancies and incorrectly classified functional, non-functional or technical work items. 
- Experience coordinating with functional analysts, test engineers, developers, application owners and quality stakeholders to resolve validation gaps without compromising release timelines. 
- Experience supporting recurring compliance activities such as Production Operational Data Updates (PODUs), SOP updates and controlled document submissions. 
- Ability to understand manual processes, identify automation opportunities and translate them into maintainable scripts, utilities or workflows. 
- Experience developing automation with suitable error handling, logging, traceability, version control and human review checkpoints. 
- Strong analytical, documentation and problem-solving skills, with careful attention to data accuracy and cross-document consistency. 
- Excellent understanding of SDLC, STLC, change control and Agile/Scrum delivery practices. 
- Experience working with geographically distributed stakeholders and managing time-sensitive release deliverables. 
Specific Technical Skills: 
- Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps for PBIs, bugs, user requirements, work item history, release scope, queries and end-to-end traceability. 
- Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, C#, JavaScript or PowerShell for workflow and data automation. 
- Experience automating validation checklist preparation, evidence collection, work-item history verification, requirements traceability and cross-document reconciliation. 
- Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel for validation checklists, reconciliation, data analysis and controlled reporting. 
- Experience with Microsoft SharePoint and Microsoft Office for controlled documentation, templates, references and supporting records. 
- Working knowledge of quality-management/change-control systems for RfC workflows. 
- Working knowledge of eJIRA or comparable tools for document-control requests and tracking. Experience with Git-based version control and CI/CD practices for managing, testing and deploying automation solutions. 
- Ability to validate automated outputs and maintain automation specifications, test results and change history before using outputs in controlled documentation. 
- Good understanding of APIs, JSON, XML, SQL and data extraction techniques is advantageous for integrating validation and reporting workflows. 
Desirable Experience: 
- Experience in a GxP-regulated, pharmaceutical, laboratory or life-sciences environment. 
- Knowledge of Computer System Validation (CSV), data integrity principles and risk-based validation approaches. 
- Experience supporting LIMS, ELN, eQMS or other regulated laboratory applications. 
- Experience automating Azure DevOps administration or reporting activities, including metrics, dashboards, sprint and work-item management. 
- Exposure to robotic process automation, low-code workflow tools or AI-assisted document and evidence checks within approved quality controls. 
- Understanding of audit preparation, inspection readiness and quality review expectations.

Personal Skills: 
- Customer-service oriented with a problem-solving attitude;
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential;
- Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change;
- Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing);
- Structured and clear writing skills;
- Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning;
- Demonstrated positive attitude, self-motivated, team player.
PERFORMANCE APPRAISAL CRITERIA: Eurofins has a strong focus on Performance Management system. This includes quarterly calibrations, half-yearly reviews and annual reviews. The KPIs shall be set and may vary slightly between projects. These will be clearly communicated, documented during the first 30 days of your joining.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test (.Net)
description:
Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.

We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.

Job Overview

We are looking for a .NET Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our Engineering team. The team works across multiple Business Units and technology initiatives, supporting new product development, application enhancements, application modernization, and integrations.

The role requires strong C# coding skills applied to test automation across UI, API, and database layers. Our environment includes both modern applications and long-running legacy systems, so the SDET must be comfortable building automation for new features as well as adding regression coverage to legacy .NET applications that are being modernized.

The ideal candidate thinks like a developer and a tester, builds maintainable automation frameworks rather than one-off scripts, embeds quality into CI/CD pipelines, and uses AI-assisted tools to speed up test creation.

Roles & Responsibilities

· Design, build, and maintain test automation frameworks in C# / .NET for UI, API, and integration testing.

· Write automated functional, regression, smoke, and end-to-end tests.

· Automate REST API testing, including contract, negative, and data-driven tests.

· Validate data and business rules at the database layer using SQL.

· Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines with quality gates and clear reporting.

· Build regression safety nets for legacy .NET applications before and during modernization.

· Review requirements and user stories for testability; define test strategy, test plans, and acceptance criteria with product and engineering.

· Perform exploratory and manual testing where automation is not cost-effective.

· Run basic performance and load tests, and help identify bottlenecks.

· Log, triage, and track defects; perform root cause analysis with developers.

· Manage test data and test environments.

· Track and report quality metrics (coverage, defect leakage, flaky test rate, pass rate).

· Participate in code reviews, including reviewing unit tests written by developers.

· Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and Business Unit stakeholders across multiple projects.

Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies.

The Software Test Engineer II will perform full-stack testing on modern web and backend applications. - Execute manual exploratory testing when automation is not feasible.

- Provide detailed test coverage reports, risk assessments, and root cause analyses.

- Understand DevOps concepts and CI/CD workflows to support continuous testing efforts.
- Work with developers to integrate test automation into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD).
- Other duties as assigned.

- Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, processes, and best practices.

Our technology supports complex healthcare workflows, from consultations and prescribing through to stock management, dispensing and fulfilment. Tens of thousands of prescriptions move through our platform every month.

  

Behind those workflows is a challenging engineering environment: multiple web applications, different organisations, user roles, permissions, configurations and interconnected processes. When an engineer changes one part of the platform, the impact can extend across several other systems.

  

Thats why test automation matters enormously to us.

We’re looking for a hands-on QA Automation Engineer who enjoys writing code, investigating technical problems and developing dependable automated tests using Playwright with TypeScript or JavaScript.

  

This is an opportunity to build genuine automation engineering skills while working on complex, production healthcare software alongside experienced QA and development colleagues.

  

**What makes this opportunity interesting?**

* **Real automation engineering:** You’ll spend your time developing and maintaining automated tests, not simply executing manual test scripts.
* **Complex, connected applications:** You’ll work with workflows crossing clinic, pharmacy and patient-facing systems, rather than testing isolated screens.
* **Meaningful technical development:** You’ll strengthen your skills in Playwright, TypeScript/JavaScript, end-to-end testing, regression automation, debugging and maintainable test design.
* **International collaboration:** You’ll work with colleagues supporting UK healthcare operations and contribute to improving the reliability of a growing SaaS product.
* **Visible impact:** Good automation makes releases safer, identifies defects earlier and gives the engineering team greater confidence to deliver changes.

  

**What you’ll be doing**

* **Build Playwright automation:** Write, execute, debug and maintain automated UI and end-to-end (E2E) tests using TypeScript or JavaScript and Playwright Test.
* **Strengthen regression coverage:** Automate important functional, integration and regression scenarios covering clinics, pharmacies and patient workflows.
* **Write maintainable test code:** Work with Page Object Model (POM) patterns, reusable helpers, test fixtures, assertions, test data and reliable locators.
* **Investigate failures:** Diagnose broken tests, timing problems, asynchronous behaviour, flaky automation and unexpected application responses.
* **Validate APIs and workflows:** Use REST API testing techniques and tools such as Postman to understand and verify application behaviour.
* **Collaborate with developers:** Reproduce bugs, explain defects clearly, verify fixes and investigate how changes affect related functionality.
* **Improve automation quality:** Use Git, review test execution results and develop your understanding of reliable testing in CI/CD pipelines.

  

**What we’re looking for**

* Approximately 1–2 years of professional software testing experience, including genuine hands-on test automation.
* Practical experience personally writing Playwright automated tests using TypeScript or JavaScript.
* Understanding of Playwright locators, assertions, automatic waiting, fixtures and Page Object Model concepts.
* Experience creating automated functional, regression or end-to-end tests for web applications.
* Basic knowledge of REST APIs, debugging, defect reporting and Git.
* A logical approach to problem-solving, attention to detail and clear written communication.
* The ability to investigate a technical problem, learn from feedback and improve your code.

  

You don’t need to have designed a complete automation framework or worked in healthcare before.

  

**Particularly useful experience**  
 Experience testing SaaS or B2B web applications, multiple user roles, permissions, REST APIs, complex workflows or configuration-driven products would be beneficial. Familiarity with CI/CD, Playwright trace debugging and AI-assisted coding tools would also be useful, although these are not prerequisites.

  

**What success looks like**  
 You’ll become someone the team can rely on to automate a feature, build meaningful assertions, investigate a failing test and explain what the evidence shows. Over time, you’ll contribute increasingly independently to automated regression coverage and the reliability of the overall test suite.

  

**Location and working arrangements**  
 We’re currently working remotely and plan to introduce hybrid working in Ahmedabad. You must be willing and able to attend the Ahmedabad office when this arrangement is implemented.

The role requires collaboration with UK-based colleagues and working hours aligned with UK operations, including evening hours in India. The precise schedule will be confirmed during recruitment.

  

**How we hire**  
 We believe practical engineering ability matters more than an impressive-looking CV. Our selection process is straightforward:

1. Apply through Naukri and answer a short set of eligibility questions.
2. Complete a practical Playwright automation assessment.
3. If you’re among the strongest performers, attend a technical interview with our senior QA automation colleague.

If you’re currently a QA Engineer, Test Automation Engineer, Software Test Engineer or junior SDET who genuinely enjoys writing automation code, we’d like to hear from you.

  

Apply through Naukri with your CV and help us improve the reliability of software supporting real healthcare operations.

* **Playwright framework architecture:** Design, extend, refactor and maintain a robust end-to-end test automation framework using Playwright with TypeScript or JavaScript.
* **Automated regression coverage:** Develop reliable E2E, functional and integration tests across clinic, pharmacy and patient-facing applications.
* **Reusable test infrastructure:** Create effective Page Object Model (POM) abstractions, custom fixtures, utilities, authentication helpers and test-data management approaches.
* **Test reliability and isolation:** Resolve flaky tests, race conditions, state leakage, brittle locators, synchronisation issues and failures caused by parallel execution.
* **API and permissions testing:** Combine UI automation with REST API validation, including testing role-based access and organisational data boundaries.
* **CI/CD integration:** Improve automated test execution in development and release pipelines, including reporting, diagnostics, traces and efficient regression runs.
* **Engineering collaboration:** Work closely with QA engineers and developers to investigate defects, review test code, identify quality risks and improve testing practices.
* **Continuous improvement:** Evaluate automation tools and AI-assisted development techniques, validating their output rather than relying on generated code without scrutiny.

  

**The experience we’re looking for**

* Approximately 3–5 years of professional software testing experience, with a substantial proportion spent writing automated test code.
* Strong, recent, hands-on Playwright automation experience using TypeScript or JavaScript.
* Demonstrable experience building, extending or materially improving an automation framework, rather than only adding individual test cases.
* Practical knowledge of Playwright Test, reusable fixtures, Page Object Model design, reliable locators, web-first assertions and test isolation.
* Experience diagnosing intermittent failures and improving automated test stability.
* Working knowledge of REST API testing, Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated test reporting and debugging tools.
* The ability to explain technical decisions, identify trade-offs and write understandable, maintainable automation code.
* Confidence reviewing other engineers’ work and supporting less experienced QA colleagues.

  

We’re interested in practical engineering ownership, not simply somebody who has held a senior title.

  

**Experience that would make you particularly interesting**

* **Multi-tenant B2B SaaS:** Applications serving different organisations with separate permissions, configurations and workflows.
* **Complex end-to-end testing:** Business processes spanning multiple applications, services or asynchronous events.
* **Scalable test architecture:** Reusable fixtures, parallel execution, test-data isolation and maintainable automation design.
* **CI/CD reliability:** Improving the speed, diagnostic value and consistency of automated testing.
* **Technical guidance:** Reviewing automation code, establishing better practices or helping other QA engineers develop.

Healthcare experience is beneficial but not required.

  

**What success looks like**  
 You’ll be able to take an unreliable or difficult-to-maintain area of our automated testing and make it measurably better. That could mean reducing flaky test failures, improving test isolation, making regression runs more useful, simplifying a framework that has become unnecessarily complicated, or introducing reliable coverage for important workflows.

  

You’ll help us move towards automation that engineers trust, understand and can extend confidently.

  

**The environment and working arrangement**  
 You’ll work with colleagues supporting a UK healthcare technology business, combining independent technical problem-solving with close collaboration across QA and development.

  

We’re currently operating remotely, with future hybrid working planned in Ahmedabad. Candidates must be willing and able to attend the Ahmedabad office when this is introduced.

  

The position requires UK-aligned working hours, including evening working in India. The exact schedule will be explained during recruitment.

  

**How we assess candidates**

Our recruitment process focuses on real engineering ability:

1. Apply through Naukri and complete the eligibility questions.
2. Complete a practical Playwright automation assessment covering test implementation, debugging, reliability and framework design.
3. The strongest candidates proceed directly to a technical interview with our senior QA automation colleague.

  

If you’ve worked as a Senior Test Automation Engineer, Senior QA Engineer, SDET or Software Development Engineer in Test, and enjoy both writing code and improving automation architecture, we’d be interested in hearing from you.

  

Apply through Naukri and help build dependable test automation for a complex, growing healthcare SaaS platform.

* Conduct periodic Management Reviews and report quality performance to top management.
* Ensure document control, revision management and traceability across all functions.
* Lead internal, external and customer audits.

  

**B. Project Quality Assurance**

This is one of the most critical responsibilities in a custom projects business.

* Establish a Project Quality Plan (PQP) for every major project.
* Review customer specifications, technical requirements and contractual quality obligations.
* Ensure quality requirements are incorporated during project planning and execution.
* Conduct quality reviews at key project milestones.
* Establish Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) covering engineering, procurement, manufacturing, assembly, testing and commissioning.
* Ensure proper control of design changes, engineering revisions and customer-approved deviations.
* Monitor project quality performance and identify potential risks at an early stage.
* Ensure proper documentation and quality records are maintained for every project.
* Participate in project review meetings and highlight quality-related risks and concerns.

  

**C. Design and Engineering Quality**

* Establish design quality assurance procedures and design review mechanisms.
* Ensure verification and validation of engineering designs.
* Ensure compliance with customer specifications, applicable codes and standards.
* Monitor Engineering Change Management (ECM) and Engineering Change Notices (ECN).
* Ensure design FMEA, risk assessments and design validation wherever applicable.
* Ensure that lessons learned from previous projects are incorporated into new designs.
* Prevent design-related quality issues from reaching manufacturing and customer sites.

  

**D. Supplier and Procurement Quality**

* Establish supplier qualification, evaluation and approval systems.
* Develop supplier quality performance monitoring mechanisms.
* Conduct supplier audits and process assessments.
* Ensure incoming material inspection and verification.
* Establish supplier corrective action procedures.
* Monitor supplier-related quality failures, rejections and delivery performance.
* Work with Procurement to improve supplier quality and reduce incoming defects.
* Ensure critical components and outsourced processes meet project-specific quality requirements.

  

**E. Manufacturing, Assembly and Process Quality**

* Establish quality control procedures at all manufacturing and assembly stages.
* Ensure compliance with approved drawings, BOMs, specifications and work instructions.
* Implement in-process inspections and final inspections.
* Establish First Article Inspection (FAI) wherever applicable.
* Ensure proper calibration and control of measuring and testing equipment.
* Drive process audits and product audits.
* Implement mistake-proofing (Poka-Yoke), process controls and preventive quality measures.
* Reduce rework, scrap, rejection and internal failure costs.

  

**F. Testing, FAT, Installation and Commissioning Quality**

* Establish testing and validation procedures for completed equipment and systems.
* Ensure Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) are conducted as per customer-approved protocols.
* Ensure test reports and inspection records are properly documented.
* Ensure compliance with customer acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate quality activities during installation and commissioning at customer premises.
* Monitor and resolve site-related quality issues.
* Ensure proper completion of quality documentation before project handover.
* Ensure customer punch points and quality observations are closed systematically.

  

**G. Customer Quality and Satisfaction**

* Act as the senior management representative for quality-related customer matters.
* Participate in customer quality reviews and audits.
* Handle major customer complaints and escalations.
* Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) using methodologies such as 8D, 5 Why and Fishbone Analysis.
* Ensure effective Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA).
* Monitor customer feedback and quality-related satisfaction levels.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer complaints.
* Build customer confidence through transparency, accountability and consistent quality performance.

  

**H. Continuous Improvement and Cost of Quality**

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across the organisation.
* Implement Lean Quality, Six Sigma and other process improvement methodologies where appropriate.
* Monitor Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ).
* Reduce rework, scrap, warranty costs and project quality failures.
* Analyse recurring quality issues and implement systemic corrective actions.
* Promote lessons learned and best practices across projects.
* Drive a zero-defect mindset and right-first-time execution.

  

**I. Team Development and Organisational Leadership**

* Build and lead a competent QA/QC team.
* Define roles, responsibilities and accountability within the quality organisation.
* Develop quality competencies through structured training.
* Mentor QA managers, project quality engineers, inspectors and supplier quality personnel.
* Establish performance appraisal and development plans.
* Promote cross-functional collaboration and ownership of quality.
* Ensure quality resources are adequately planned for all ongoing projects.

  

**3. Educational qualifications and professional experience**

**Educational qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics / Production / Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in Engineering or Quality Management is an advantage.
* Lead Auditor qualification in ISO 9001.
* Six Sigma Green Belt / Black Belt certification is desirable.
* Training in project management, FMEA, RCA and CAPA.

**Experience requirements**

* Minimum 15 years of relevant experience in Quality Assurance and Quality Control.
* At least 5 years in a senior management or leadership position.
* Experience in custom-engineered products, capital equipment, machinery manufacturing, automation systems or project-based engineering businesses.
* Proven experience managing quality across multiple concurrent customer projects.
* Experience in customer audits, supplier audits, FAT, installation and commissioning quality.
* Demonstrated ability to manage cross-functional teams and resolve critical quality issues.

  

**4. Essential competencies and leadership qualities**

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

1. **Strong technical understanding:** Ability to understand engineering drawings, specifications, manufacturing processes, electrical and mechanical systems and testing requirements.
2. **Project business understanding:** Ability to manage quality across the complete project lifecycle rather than focusing only on manufacturing inspection.
3. **Leadership:** Ability to influence and drive quality accountability across all departments.
4. **Problem-solving:** Strong analytical skills and structured root cause investigation.
5. **Customer orientation:** Ability to manage demanding customer expectations and quality escalations.
6. **Decision-making:** Ability to make independent quality decisions, including stopping activities when serious quality risks exist.
7. **Communication:** Strong communication and negotiation skills with customers, suppliers and internal management.
8. **Business orientation:** Ability to balance quality, cost, delivery and customer satisfaction without compromising essential quality requirements.

description:
Job Summary

Synechron is seeking a Senior QA Automation Engineer to lead quality assurance for a payment clearing platform. The role will validate payment processing, financial messaging, settlement, and reconciliation workflows while building reliable automation for continuous delivery. You will also support AI-driven testing and collaborate with Product, Engineering, and DevOps teams to improve platform quality and release confidence.

Software Requirements

Required

* Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript: 3+ years.
* Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or equivalent: 2+ years.
* API testing using REST Assured, Postman, Karate, or equivalent.
* SQL and relational database validation.
* Git and pull-request workflows.
* Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or equivalent CI/CD tools.
* Test management and defect tracking tools.
* Docker or equivalent container technology.
* XML, JSON, CSV, ISO 20022, or SWIFT message validation.

Preferred

* JUnit, TestNG, PyTest, Robot Framework, or equivalent.
* Kafka, RabbitMQ, or other messaging platforms.
* JMeter, Gatling, or equivalent performance-testing tools.
* Service virtualization and mocking tools.
* AI-assisted test generation, self-healing automation, or predictive defect analysis.
* Cloud, observability, and infrastructure-as-code tools.

Overall Responsibilities

* Develop and execute a risk-based QA strategy for payment clearing systems.
* Validate payment lifecycles, ISO 20022 and SWIFT messages, settlement rules, exceptions, and reconciliation.
* Build and maintain automated API, integration, UI, and end-to-end regression suites.
* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Create synthetic, compliance-safe test data for complex clearing scenarios.
* Investigate defects using logs, messages, databases, and transaction traces.
* Apply AI-supported testing for test generation, script maintenance, and defect analysis.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Developers, DevOps, and Business Analysts.
* Support release decisions with clear test results, defect trends, and risk assessments.
* Improve test coverage, execution efficiency, reliability, and traceability.

Technical Skills (By Category)

* **Programming Essential:** Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript.  
  **Preferred:** Experience with more than one language and event-driven systems.
* **Databases and Data — Essential:** SQL, relational databases, data validation, reconciliation, synthetic test data, and data masking.  
  **Preferred:** Data warehouses, distributed databases, and event-stream validation.
* **Cloud Technologies — Essential:** Cloud-hosted environments, service dependencies, logs, and access controls.  
  **Preferred:** Containers, orchestration, managed cloud services, and infrastructure as code.
* **Frameworks and Libraries — Essential:** UI and API automation frameworks; XML and JSON validation.  
  **Preferred:** Contract testing, service virtualization, performance testing, and AI-enabled testing frameworks.
* **Development Tools and Methodologies — Essential:** Git, CI/CD, Agile delivery, defect management, test reporting, code review, and quality gates.  
  **Preferred:** Test analytics, resilience testing, and observability platforms.
* **Security Protocols — Essential:** Secure test data handling, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, TLS, secrets management, and role-based access.  
  **Preferred:** Security testing, digital signatures, certificate management, and regulated financial services controls.

Experience Requirements

* 3–5 years of experience in QA automation or quality engineering.
* Experience testing fintech platforms, payment gateways, clearing systems, banking platforms, or transaction-processing systems.
* Practical experience with automated regression testing, APIs, databases, distributed services, and CI/CD.
* Experience with payment messages, settlement, reconciliation, exception handling, or transaction controls.
* Preferred experience with ISO 20022, SWIFT, high-volume processing, or regulated environments.
* Equivalent experience in software development, platform engineering, payment operations, or production support may be considered where strong automation capability is demonstrated.

Day-to-Day Activities

* Design payment and clearing test scenarios, including negative and recovery cases.
* Develop, execute, and maintain automated tests.
* Validate messages, transaction statuses, settlement results, and reconciliation outputs.
* Create test data and manage test environments.
* Review failures, logs, database records, and service responses.
* Participate in planning, refinement, defect triage, release discussions, and retrospectives.
* Review automation code and document test results, risks, and dependencies.
* Recommend quality improvements and escalate issues affecting payment accuracy, security, compliance, or release readiness.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* ISTQB, Agile, DevOps, cloud, or payment-industry certifications are preferred.
* Completion of Synechron training in security, data protection, compliance, quality practices, and responsible AI.
* Ongoing development in payment technology, automation, cloud delivery, security, and AI-assisted testing is expected.

Professional Competencies

* Analytical problem-solving and root-cause investigation.
* Clear communication with technical and business stakeholders.
* Collaboration across Product, Engineering, DevOps, and Operations.
* Ability to prioritize work based on payment risk and customer impact.
* Adaptability to changing technologies and requirements.
* Evidence-based innovation, including responsible use of AI.
* Commitment to accurate documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

Senior Automation Engineer QA – Sage Intacct
  
  
About Sage
  
  
Sage is a global technology company that provides software and services to help businesses manage their finances, operations and people. Sage supports businesses of different sizes with solutions spanning accounting, enterprise resource planning (ERP), payroll and financial management.
  
  
Sage Intacct is a cloud-based financial management solution designed to help organisations streamline accounting processes, gain financial visibility and make informed business decisions. Quality, reliability and integration capabilities are essential to delivering a trusted experience for customers.
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer who combines strong functional testing expertise with hands-on test automation and API testing skills. The role involves validating Sage Intacct business workflows, ERP functionality and payment integrations, while developing reliable automated tests to improve quality, coverage and delivery confidence.
  
  
The ideal candidate can independently understand requirements, identify functional and integration risks, design and execute test scenarios, investigate defects, and automate high-value regression scenarios.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Functional QA and Domain Validation
  
  
- Understand business requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, translating them into comprehensive test scenarios and test cases.
  
- Perform functional, integration, regression, exploratory and end-to-end testing across Sage Intacct workflows.
  
- Validate ERP business processes, data accuracy, business rules, transaction processing and system behaviour.
  
- Test payment-related workflows and integrations, including transaction outcomes, error handling and reconciliation scenarios.
  
- Identify edge cases, negative scenarios and potential business risks.
  
- Investigate defects and collaborate with engineering and product teams to drive resolution.

- Design, develop and maintain automated tests using Selenium and/or Playwright with Python or Java.

Quality Engineering and Delivery
  
  
- Participate in requirement reviews, test planning, defect triage and release readiness assessments.
  
- Collaborate with developers, product managers, business analysts and QA engineers throughout the development lifecycle.
  
- Report test progress, risks, defects and quality metrics clearly.

- Strong understanding of functional, regression, integration and end-to-end testing.
  
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution.
  
- Familiarity with version control and defect tracking tools.
  
  
Functional and Domain Knowledge
  
  
- Experience testing enterprise applications, preferably ERP or financial software.
  
- Understanding of business workflows, transaction processing, data validation and system integrations.
  
- Exposure to payment processing or financial integrations is highly desirable.
  
- Ability to understand complex business requirements and validate both functional outcomes and technical behaviour.
  
  
DevOps and Delivery Fundamentals
  
  
- Familiarity with build pipelines, CI/CD practices and test execution across environments.
  
- Basic troubleshooting of environment-related issues.
  
- Experience working within Agile development teams.
  
  
Experience and Qualifications
  
  
- Typically 6+ years of QA experience combining functional testing and test automation.
  
- Demonstrated ability to own testing for a feature or business workflow from requirement analysis through release validation.
  
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.
  
- Experience in ERP, accounting, financial software or payment integrations is an advantage.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
- Business-critical workflows and integrations are thoroughly validated before release.
  
- Functional defects and API integration risks are identified early.
  
- Automation improves UI and API regression coverage and reduces repetitive testing effort.
  
- Releases are supported by clear evidence of test coverage, quality risks and readiness.
